evidence.quote:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

observations.why: Establishes a mandatory, settled operational gate ('now requires... before it ships').

evidence.quote:
We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate.

observations.why: Plain factual assertion offered as the justification for the gate.

evidence.quote: **Gate**: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: Formally records and ratifies the requirement as a decision item.
Formally specifies the operational scope of the ratified decision.
Formally assigns ownership for the established gate.
